headline: Malaysian Ringgit Weakens to Near Five-Month Low as KLCI Falls
summary: Bursa Malaysia's FBM KLCI ended lower on heavyweight selling, while the ringgit touched a near five-month low against the US dollar despite robust domestic GDP growth figures.
why: Emerging market currencies and benchmarks face pressure when US interest rate expectations firm and global equity sentiment turns risk-averse.

impacts.name: Malaysian Ringgit
impacts.why: The ringgit experienced one of its steepest declines since mid-June against the dollar due to global market uncertainty.
